positions.name: KnowledgeRemovalDirective
positions.frame: how is a directive to erase knowledge performed when issued as flat operational housekeeping?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives from the same speaker commanding the erasure of specific knowledge domains — one targeting named artifacts (the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts), the other targeting a general category (zeppelin routes). The directional reads converge across every dimension: calm-negative affect (resigned clearing-away), formal-to-matter-of-fact register, present-tense irrealis (desired state-change), authority-ranking relational stance, legitimate informational power, and decision-level conviction (settled instruction, not argued). The shared read is how knowledge-removal is commanded in a low-arousal, operational register — the frame holds both the concrete and the abstract variant without tension.
